description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You draw an Overflow effect.

Advance your Reckoning by two stages instead of one. The Overflow effect you draw is heightened by 2 ranks, to a maximum of the highest rank you can normally draw. You must be able to advance two full stages to do this — you cannot use it to reach a stage you have not yet unlocked, and you cannot use it above Stage III until Stage IV is unlocked at 13th level.
